facts.label: Where
facts.value: AMS 1944 sheet read, fit rms 95 m

facts.label: Note
facts.value: the canal leaving 昆明湖 at its south tip (绣漪桥) and running south-east to 广源闸 and the city; its course is older than 1860 (C for 1860 from this map alone) Also: not placed: runs south of the ring's south edge (39.972) from 绣漪桥 at the lake's south tip; today's 南长河 keeps the line from 长春桥 (S1226) (Long River (昆明湖 -> 高梁桥 -> 西直门), the imperial boat route). Also: LoC Beijing cheng jiao tu c.1886 read, fit rms 226 m (Chang He), 995 m from the point used.
